title: 地理与物产介绍词汇
goal: 掌握地理物产词汇并对应地区条件

points.label: 识别地理与物产的常用词
对应地区条件和物产特点

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）
sources.used: 课程内容所依据的考试大纲

body.p: 地区介绍涉及地貌、气候、种植和产品用途。译文须对应条件与物产的关系。例：Tea grows on the hills. 表示茶生长在丘陵上。

cards.title: 词汇表：地貌气候
rows: The plain lies beside a river.
A river runs through the valley.
The lake lies north of the town.
The soil is suitable for crops.
The region has a mild climate.
The land is dry in winter.

cards.title: 词汇表：种植生产
rows: Farmers harvest the grain in autumn.
Farmers grow tea on the hills.

cards.title: 词汇表：产品用途
rows: The grain is used for food.
The seeds are used to make oil.
The fiber is made into cloth.
Tea is prepared as a drink.
Farmers sell fruit at the market.
Farmers store grain in a dry place.

body.p: 中文：这个地区有低矮的丘陵和一条河流，气候温暖，雨水充足。农民在山坡上种茶，在河边的平地种植蔬菜。茶叶采收后经过加工，既供当地居民饮用，也在市场出售。河水还用于灌溉田地，帮助作物生长。

body.box: This region has low hills and a river. Its climate is warm and rainfall is plentiful. Farmers grow tea on the hillsides and vegetables on the flat land beside the river. After harvest, the tea is processed for local residents to drink and for sale at the market. River water is also used to irrigate the fields and support crop growth.

body.p: on the hillsides 对应茶的种植地点，beside the river 对应蔬菜的种植地点。加工后的茶用于饮用和出售。

groups.fill: A region has a river and low hills. Its cli{mate} is warm and the so{il} is suitable for farming. Farmers gr{ow} tea on the hi{lls} and vegetables in the fields beside the ri{ver}. They irri{gate} the fields with river water. After the tea har{vest}, workers pro{cess} the leaves. Some tea is sold at the local mar{ket}, while some is prepared as a dr{ink}. The farms also supply fresh vegetables to families in nearby towns throughout the growing season.

groups.text: 中文：一个山谷气候温和，农民在河边种植水果。部分水果新鲜出售，其余晒干后储存。河水用于灌溉果树，附近市场出售新鲜水果。晒干的水果便于保存，居民也可以在水果收获季节以外食用。河流是这个山谷的重要水源。

options: By the river in the valley
Where the dried fruit is kept
Outside the valley by a river
items.why: 原文说水果种植在山谷中的河边，对应第一项。

items.stem: What happens to some of the fruit?
options: It is dried and then sold.
It is sold while still fresh.
It is stored without being dried.
It is sold at a distant market.
items.why: 原文说部分水果新鲜出售，对应第二项。晒干的是其余的水果，晒干后储存，不是出售。

items.stem: What happens before the remaining fruit is stored?
options: It is sold fresh at the market.
It is soaked in river water.
It is dried in the sun first.
It is eaten during the season.
items.why: 原文说其余水果晒干后储存，对应第三项。

items.stem: What is the river water used for?
items.why: 原文说河水用于灌溉果树，对应第四项。

items.stem: What is an advantage of drying the fruit?
options: It keeps well after the harvest season.
It sells better at the nearby market.
It can be eaten only in the harvest season.
The trees need less water from the river.
items.why: 原文说晒干的水果便于保存，可在收获季节以外食用，对应第一项。

groups.fill: A rural region lies beside a river. Its wide pl{ain} has fertile so{il}, and its cli{mate} is mi{ld}. Farmers currently gr{ow} wheat in large fie{lds}. After the har{vest}, the gr{ain} is ground into fl{our}. Some flour is sold at a local mar{ket}, while the rest is used to make food for nearby families. The river supplies water for the fields, and the farmland also supports vegetables. Farmers work together to store their products in a dry place until they are needed.

groups.text: 中文：一个地区的平原靠近河流，气候温和，土壤适合种植小麦。农民春季播种，秋季收获。收获的小麦一部分磨成面粉，供当地制作食物，其余在市场出售。河水用于灌溉田地，帮助作物生长。当地居民也食用这些食物。

items.why: 原文说平原靠近河流，对应第二项。

items.stem: What crop is suited to the soil?
items.why: 原文说平原的土壤适合种植小麦，对应第三项。面粉是小麦加工后的产品，不是作物。

items.stem: When do farmers harvest the wheat?
items.why: 原文说农民秋季收获，对应第四项。

items.stem: What is some of the harvested wheat made into?
items.why: 原文说一部分小麦磨成面粉，供当地制作食物，对应第一项。在市场出售的是其余的小麦，不是面粉。

items.stem: What is the river water used for?
items.why: 原文说河水用于灌溉田地，对应第二项。
